This creates a network effect, accelerating the inflow of funds and making the scheme appear more successful.  Referral bonuses and tiered rewards further encourage recruitment, essentially turning existing investors into unwitting salespeople.  Arthur understands the power of social proof – the more people who *appear* to be benefiting, the more attractive the scheme becomes.
